Explore IIT Certification Courses Advanced Certification in Data Science & AI Advanced Certification in Data Analytics Advanced Certification in Cloud Computing & Azure Programming Advanced Certification in Cloud Computing & DevOps Advanced Certification in Full Stack Development Advanced Certification in React JS & Angular Web Development Home > Saurabh Ujawane: From Computer Science Graduate to DevOps Engineer at Geta AI Labs Saurabh Ujawane: From Computer Science Graduate to DevOps Engineer at Geta AI Labs Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri July 8, 2026 12:21 pm Introduction Saurabh Ujawane’s journey showcases how advanced education combined with practical industry training can lead to a successful career in DevOps. With a Master’s degree in Computer Science, he had a strong academic foundation but wanted to develop hands-on expertise that aligned with current industry demands. By enhancing his practical skills and staying focused on his career goals, he secured a position as a DevOps Engineer at Geta AI Labs Private Limited , marking the beginning of a promising career in cloud and automation. Background Although Saurabh possessed in-depth theoretical knowledge through his postgraduate studies, he understood that the IT industry values professionals who can apply concepts in real-world environments. To bridge the gap between academics and industry expectations, he decided to strengthen his technical capabilities in DevOps. While exploring career-oriented programs, he chose DevOps classes in Pune to gain practical exposure to modern development and deployment practices. Upskilling with 3RI Technologies Saurabh enrolled in the Step in DevOps Engineering program at 3RI Technologies, where he received hands-on training from experienced industry professionals. The course covered essential DevOps tools and technologies, including Linux, Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, and CI/CD automation. Through live projects, lab sessions, and interview preparation, he developed the confidence to solve real-world infrastructure and deployment challenges while improving his technical and problem-solving abilities. Transition to Company With the support of 3RI Technologies’ placement team and his dedication to continuous learning, Saurabh successfully secured an opportunity with Geta AI Labs Private Limited . His strong technical foundation, project experience, and practical understanding of DevOps workflows helped him perform confidently throughout the hiring process. The transition from academic learning to a professional IT role became smooth because of his consistent effort and industry-focused training. Achievements as a DevOps Engineer As a DevOps Engineer at Geta AI Labs Private Limited , Saurabh works on automating deployment pipelines, managing cloud infrastructure, and improving software delivery processes. He collaborates with development and operations teams to build scalable, reliable, and efficient solutions using modern DevOps practices. His career journey highlights how practical learning and continuous upskilling can create exciting opportunities after completing DevOps classes in Pune . Conclusion Saurabh Ujawane’s success story reflects the importance of combining academic knowledge with real-world technical skills. Through the practical training, live projects, and placement support offered by 3RI Technologies, he successfully launched his career as a DevOps Engineer at Geta AI Labs Private Limited . His achievement serves as motivation for aspiring professionals who want to build a successful future in the rapidly evolving DevOps ecosystem.
